# Independent hero critic — round 3

Score: 8/10 for posing, clothing fit and appearance in the inspected actual frames. No blocking model, clothing or material fault found; pappa identity preserved.

V2 clearly improves anticipation, outward impact and shared shaft grip across all eight tools. Sleeve/cuff volume is substantially improved. Walking retains body motion without V1's excessive lean and elevated appearance. Cloth, leather and metal remain distinct at game size.

Scope: the critic inspected ordered frames and numerical reports, not video playback. The result is not an independent approval of perceived rhythm, transitions or foot sliding at normal speed. The final video therefore supplies genuine normal-30fps motion for user inspection, including a clear native close-up beside the large ore that obscures the game camera angle. No further redesign recommended.

Evidence: candidate-v2-mine-1.jpg, candidate-v2-walk-1.jpg, integrated-final/mining-sheet.jpg, integrated-final/eight-tools.jpg, actual game screenshots and complete 271-frame native report. Rounds 1 and 2 rejected the original close-face free-hand swing, collapsing sleeve and over-lifted human-leg retarget; those were corrected before this review.
